description: Builds valid schema.org JSON-LD for a page: FAQ, local business, organization, article or blog post, product, person or breadcrumb. Checks the properties Google lists as required for that type (per Google Search Central structured data docs, developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data) and returns a ready-to-paste script tag.

data.description: Fields for that type. faq: questions [{question, answer}]. local_business: name, business_type (for example Dentist), address {street, locality, region, postal_code, country}, telephone, url, image, price_range, geo {latitude, longitude}, opening_hours [{days: [Monday...], opens: "09:00", closes: "18:00"}]. organization: name, organization_type, url, logo, description, legal_name, founding_date, email, telephone, same_as [urls], address. article: headline, article_type (Article, BlogPosting or NewsArticle), url, images [urls], date_published, date_modified, authors [{name, url, job_title}], publisher {name, logo}. product: name, description, images, brand, sku, price, currency, availability (InStock, OutOfStock, PreOrder, SoldOut), price_valid_until, rating_value, review_count. person: name, url, job_title, works_for, image, description, same_as. breadcrumb: items [{name, url}].

name: schema_generator
title: Schema markup (JSON-LD) generator
